title.text: Outside London, net migration says little about job churn in either period
subtitle: ITL2 regions outside London: net longer-distance migration (between English regions and nations) against job reallocation, pooled over each period.
Same axes in both panels. Grey line = fit; dotted line = average reallocation outside London. 2020–24 includes COVID and ONS's 2023 migration method change.
Sources: ONS Longitudinal Business Database (Secure Access, SN 9501); ONS and National Records of Scotland internal migration; ONS, NRS and NISRA population estimates; authors' calculations.
